tickets.problem: The VPN connection drops every time the laptop wakes from sleep.
tickets.resolution: Updated the VPN client and confirmed it stayed connected after waking the laptop.

tickets.problem: The VPN reports a certificate error before connecting.
tickets.resolution: Renewed the device certificate and reconnected.

tickets.problem: The network printer shows as offline after switching to a new router.
tickets.resolution: Assigned a reserved IP address and updated the printer port.

tickets.problem: Pages from the office laser printer have a vertical black stripe.
tickets.resolution: Replaced the toner cartridge and printed a clean test page.

tickets.problem: The user cannot approve the MFA prompt after replacing their phone.
tickets.resolution: Reset the old MFA registration and enrolled the new phone.

tickets.problem: A new team member gets access denied when opening the finance shared drive.
tickets.resolution: Added the user to the finance read-only access group after approval.

tickets.problem: Outlook keeps asking for a password even though webmail works.
tickets.resolution: Removed stale Office credentials and signed in again.

tickets.problem: Teams meetings have no microphone audio when connected through the USB dock.
tickets.resolution: Selected the USB headset microphone in Teams and verified it on a test call.

tickets.problem: The browser shows an invalid certificate on the internal helpdesk portal.
tickets.resolution: Installed the renewed portal certificate with the complete trust chain.

tickets.problem: Meeting-room Wi-Fi cuts out whenever both rooms are in use.
The remote desktop app displays a black screen after sign-in.
tickets.resolution: Updated the graphics driver and disabled bitmap caching for that connection.

tickets.problem: The laptop will not charge through the USB-C dock after a firmware update.
tickets.resolution: Power-cycled the dock and installed the corrected dock firmware.

tickets.problem: The VPN disconnects after resuming from standby on Windows.
tickets.resolution: Disabled the network adapter power-saving option and verified the VPN after standby.
